headline: Anthropic Makes Historic Stock Market Debut With Peak $1.3 Trillion Valuation
summary: AI firm Anthropic achieved a peak valuation of $1.3 trillion during its initial public offering, marking a historic debut for the creator of the Claude chatbot.
why: Anthropic is a prominent artificial intelligence developer and maker of the Claude chatbot, and its public valuation sets a benchmark for the AI sector.

impacts.name: Artificial Intelligence
impacts.why: The massive IPO valuation reflects heavy market focus and spending on artificial intelligence.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A record-breaking initial public offering drove the AI giant's valuation to $1.3 trillion amid broader market volatility.
